Process.title: How we work
Process.subtitle: From the first contact to a live product, you know what happens at each stage and what you get at the end of it.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.description: We learn about your business, the goal of the project and your time and budget constraints.
steps.deliverable: clarity on the problem and the next steps.

steps.title: Proposal & scope
steps.description: We turn the conversation into a detailed scope: what is in, what is out, and the timeline.
steps.deliverable: a proposal with scope, timeline and investment.

steps.title: Development
steps.description: Every week you see the product working and can change course before it turns into rework.

steps.title: Launch & support
steps.description: We go live, follow the first days of real use and fix whatever comes up.
steps.deliverable: a live product and 30 days of support included.

faq.question: How much does a project cost?
faq.answer: It depends on the scope. After the discovery call, we send a proposal with defined scope, timeline and investment within 3 business days. The call and the proposal are free and with no commitment.

faq.question: What happens after I get in touch?
faq.answer: We book a 30-minute call to understand the project. If it makes sense for both sides, you get the proposal and, once it is approved, we start with weekly demos.

faq.question: Do you work with companies outside Brazil?
faq.answer: Yes. KingFix, for example, is an on-demand car repair platform in Toronto, Canada. Our site and our communication work in both Portuguese and English.

faq.question: What happens after delivery?
faq.answer: The first 30 days of support are included. After that, we can agree on ongoing maintenance and product evolution.

kingfix.title: KingFix
kingfix.description: More than a system: a sales engine. Intelligent scheduling with automatic distance calculation (Google Maps API) and location-based pricing. The customer chooses, the system handles logistics. Integrated checkout (Stripe), complete financial and administrative management. The definitive Mobile-First solution to scale mobile mechanic services.

devrex.title: DevRex
devrex.description: The definitive bridge for your international career. Micro-SaaS platform that uses AI to analyze profiles and automate LinkedIn applications. Find the best global remote jobs with surgical precision and increase your hiring chances.

mycard4you.title: MyCard4You
mycard4you.description: Innovative platform to create, customize, and schedule interactive virtual cards for special occasions. Features photo uploads, soundtracks, and visual effects with integrated payments.

codesampa.title: codesampa.io
codesampa.description: The site you are looking at. Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, in two languages, with an MDX blog (Velite) and its own design system.

psialexia.title: Psi Aléxia Marques
psialexia.description: Pure performance focused on results. Built with Vanilla HTML, CSS, JS + Tailwind to achieve maximum Lighthouse scores and flawless SEO. The impact? Just 2 weeks after launch, patient demand was so high that the professional quit her full-time job to focus entirely on her private practice.

codelab.title: CodeLab
codelab.description: Complete learning management system. Fullstack Next.js and Prisma architecture with JSON-based course structuring. Features native payment gateway (Asaas) and AI integration for student support.

finance_ai.title: Finance AI
finance_ai.description: Personal finance SaaS. Leverages Artificial Intelligence to analyze spending, automatically categorize transactions, and generate personalized saving insights.
